test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 5 men and 2 women can reap 48 hectares in 3 days, and if 3 men and 1 woman can reap 54 hectares in 6 days, then how many women must assist 6 men to reap 378 hectares in 14 days?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ 5M + 2W → 48 in 3 days ⇒ per day = 16 3M + 1W → 54 in 6 days ⇒ per day = 9 From second: 3M + W = 9 ⇒ W = 9 − 3M Substitute in first: 5M + 2(9 − 3M) = 16 ⇒ M = 2 ⇒ W = 3 Required work per day = 378 ÷ 14 = 27 6M + xW = 12 + 3x = 27 ⇒ x = 5 **∴ Answer = 5 women**
